Bug_Details:
According to the J2EE specification, an EJB should not have any static fields
with write access. However, static read-only fields are allowed. This ensures proper
behavior especially when instances are distributed by the container on several JREs.
Bug_Explanation: The 'javax.ejb.Stateless' annotation has been removed, as it is not required to demonstrate the bug. The 'counter' field has been made static, as it is required to be static according to the bug rule. The 'doSomething' method has been modified to increment the 'counter' field. The 'getCounter' method has been added to return the value of the 'counter' field. The'showBug' method has been added to demonstrate the bug, which is that the 'counter' field is not final and can be modified from outside the class.
